description:
Fetch time series data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics. Returns monthly/quarterly/annual observations for employment, wages, prices, and more.

Popular series IDs:
- CES0000000001: Total nonfarm employment (thousands)
- LNS14000000: Unemployment rate
- CUUR0000SA0: CPI-U All Items
- CES0500000003: Average hourly earnings, total private
- JTS000000000000000JOR: Job openings rate (JOLTS)
- PRS85006092: Nonfarm business labor productivity

Series ID prefixes: CES (jobs by industry), LNS (unemployment), CU (CPI), WP (PPI), OE (wages), JT (JOLTS)

Series can also be built for you:
- laus_areas: local unemployment (LAUS) for states or 5-digit county FIPS codes, with laus_measure
- oews_occupations: wages or employment by occupation (OEWS, annual) for SOC codes like '15-1252' (software developers), '29-1141' (registered nurses), with oews_measure, nationally or in oews_state

laus_areas.description: States (name or code) or 5-digit county FIPS codes, comma-separated: 'TX, California, 06037'

oews_state.description: State for OEWS (name or code); omit for national

series_ids.description: Comma-separated BLS series IDs (max 50 in total). Example: 'CES0000000001,LNS14000000,CUUR0000SA0'

start_year.description: Start year (default: 3 years ago). Max 20 year range with API key, 10 without.

name: bls_series_data
